summary: Doctor reports cached store-retention health and warns about disabled checkpoints and unreclaimable free pages

schema.detail: No schema changes. The hourly sampler reads indexed checkpoint metadata and auto_vacuum.

rules.detail: Retention rules and checkpoint digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Doctor adds store-retention. The performance database row adds checkpoint_disabled and sampled checkpoint and auto_vacuum fields. Telemetry adds st.db.checkpoint.disabled.

manual.detail: No configuration changes or database maintenance are performed.

recovery.detail: Older builds ignore the additional report fields.
